title: Active task
description: The one active task of a checkout, .ai/local/state/current.yaml. The identity fields are computed from git at write time and never authored.

requires.description: The obligations this task owes before the outcome completed is available. Token names come from share/obligations.yaml. Absent or empty means the task owes nothing beyond the rest of the contract, which is how every task behaved before obligations existed.

issue.description: The issue the worker said this task executes (start --issue). A name, not state: what it serves is derived by intents.binding on every read (ADR 0111).

intent.description: The intent the worker said this task serves (start --intent). A name, not state: its stage, verdict and criteria are stored nowhere.

exemption.description: The exemption class the worker gave (start --exempt), one the policy declares under intent.exemptions.

exemption_because.description: The reason given with the exemption.

binding.description: The standing intents.binding answered when the task started. A record of what start was told, never read back as the current standing.

plan_revision.description: The pin of what the work was for when the task started: a hash compared on a later read, never a stage or a verdict.

evidence_standing.description: The pin of where the served criteria's evidence stood when the task started.

scope_widened_at.description: When the scope was last widened (`scope widen`); every widening is a task.scope_widened event.

scope_widened_because.description: Why the scope was last widened.

worktree.description: The checkout this task belongs to, computed from git and never authored. One task per worktree, so the overlap report can tell another worktree's claim from this one's.

mesh_claim.description: The key of the advisory claim `start` took on the mesh for this task's scope, as the mesh session task-<id>, when the checkout's shared server answered (I2288). Absent when no server answered; `finish` closes the session.
